i18n.en: What do you imagine your region will look like in fifty years?

i18n.en: Which map projection do you think shows the world most fairly?

i18n.es: ¿Qué proyección cartográfica crees que muestra el mundo de forma más justa?

i18n.es: ¿Cómo crees que las imágenes de satélite cambian nuestra forma de entender la Tierra?

i18n.en: If you could create your own thematic map, what would it show?

i18n.en: How do you think cities can keep growing while staying green?

i18n.en: Which curious place, like an enclave or a microstate, would you love to visit?

i18n.en: How do ocean currents or winds influence the climate where you live?
